name: CyberThreatAgent-Bench
purpose: Stage-wise evaluation of a nine-stage alert-to-mitigation threat-analysis pipeline.

rule_corpus.licence: SigmaHQ rules are DRL-1.1; verify before redistribution

sources.chain_corpus: synthetic, generated by build_chain_corpus() from this notebook

sampling: rules are filtered to those carrying >=1 ATT&CK tag, de-duplicated on normalised text, labels with a single rule dropped, then capped per label
label_provenance: labels are Sigma rule author tags, NOT analyst-verified incident labels; no inter-annotator agreement exists

splits.closed_set_filter: yes -- test labels must appear in train (stated limitation)

known_biases: labels derive from detection logic, not from incidents
Windows-heavy: rules/windows dominates the rule corpus
first-tag bias affects the single-label view (attack_id = tags[0])
chain corpus is synthetic; no real traffic or host telemetry
closed-set primary split; only cell 21 is open-set
uses: research benchmark for multi-stage threat-analysis evaluation
not_for: operational deployment, or any claim of calibrated risk
